_note: Optional places NOT in the plan, best first. Distances = straight line from the hotel × 1.35 (approx. road distance); times at city traffic speed from Hanoi Chic Boutique Hotel (51-53 Bat Su). Hours checked Oct 2026 — confirm locally. Kannada needs a native proofread.

places.en: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum & One Pillar Pagoda
places.vi: Lăng Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh & Chùa Một Cột
places.kn: ಹೋ ಚಿ ಮಿನ್ ಸಮಾಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂಟಿ ಕಂಬದ ದೇವಾಲಯ
places.addr_vi: Lăng Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh, 1 Hùng Vương, Ba Đình, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum, 1 Hùng Vương, Ba Đình, Hà Nội
places.why_en: Vietnam's most important national monument. See the leader who is called 'Uncle Ho', the big Ba Dinh Square, and the tiny One Pillar Pagoda that stands on a single pillar like a lotus.
places.why_kn: ವಿಯೆಟ್ನಾಂನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮುಖ್ಯ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸ್ಮಾರಕ. 'ಹೋ ಚಿಕ್ಕಪ್ಪ' ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುವ ನಾಯಕನ ಸಮಾಧಿ, ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬಾ ದಿನ್ ಮೈದಾನ, ಮತ್ತು ಕಮಲದಂತೆ ಒಂದೇ ಕಂಬದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತಿರುವ ಪುಟ್ಟ ದೇವಾಲಯ.
places.best_en: Mornings only: 8:00–11:00 am in November. Go at opening — the queue grows fast. Closed Monday and Friday.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Sun 29 Nov, 7:45 am (with One Pillar Pagoda)
places.walk_en: Flat, but 30–60 min standing in the queue
places.tip_en: Cover shoulders and knees. No photos inside. Bags are kept at the counter.
places.tip_kn: ಭುಜ ಮತ್ತು ಮೊಣಕಾಲು ಮುಚ್ಚುವ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಧರಿಸಿ. ಒಳಗೆ ಫೋಟೋ ಇಲ್ಲ.
places.go: Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum, 1 Hùng Vương, Ba Đình, Hà Nội

places.addr_vi: Chùa Trấn Quốc, 46 đường Thanh Niên, Tây Hồ, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Tran Quoc Pagoda, 46 Thanh Niên, Tây Hồ, Hà Nội
places.why_en: Hanoi's oldest pagoda, about 1,500 years old, with a red tower on a small island in West Lake. Its Bodhi tree was grown from the Bodh Gaya tree and gifted by India's President Rajendra Prasad in 1959.
places.why_kn: ಹನೋಯ್‌ನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹಳೆಯ ಬೌದ್ಧ ವಿಹಾರ, ಸುಮಾರು 1,500 ವರ್ಷ ಹಳೆಯದು. ಸರೋವರದ ಪುಟ್ಟ ದ್ವೀಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಂಪು ಗೋಪುರ. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಬೋಧಿ ವೃಕ್ಷವನ್ನು 1959ರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಪತಿ ರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ ಪ್ರಸಾದ್ ಬೋಧಗಯಾದಿಂದ ಉಡುಗೊರೆಯಾಗಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
places.best_en: Afternoon after 1:30 pm (closed 11:30–1:30 for lunch). About 30–40 min.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Thu 26 Nov, 2:30 pm
places.walk_en: Easy — flat, short walk on a causeway
places.tip_en: Cover shoulders and knees. Remove shoes inside the shrine.
places.tip_kn: ಭುಜ, ಮೊಣಕಾಲು ಮುಚ್ಚಿ. ಒಳಗೆ ಚಪ್ಪಲಿ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.
places.go: Tran Quoc Pagoda, 46 Thanh Niên, Tây Hồ, Hà Nội

places.addr_vi: Hoàng thành Thăng Long, 19C Hoàng Diệu, Ba Đình, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, 19c Hoàng Diệu, Ba Đình, Hà Nội
places.why_en: The royal palace of Vietnam's kings for about 1,000 years, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Big old gate, palace foundations and green gardens — calm and uncrowded.
places.why_kn: ಸುಮಾರು 1,000 ವರ್ಷ ವಿಯೆಟ್ನಾಂ ರಾಜರ ಅರಮನೆ, ಈಗ ಯುನೆಸ್ಕೋ ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆ ತಾಣ. ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹಳೆಯ ಹೆಬ್ಬಾಗಿಲು, ಅರಮನೆಯ ಅಡಿಪಾಯ, ಹಸಿರು ತೋಟ — ಶಾಂತ ಸ್ಥಳ.
places.best_en: 8:00 am, when it opens — cool and quiet. Open 8:00–5:00.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Fri 27 Nov, 8:00 am
places.walk_en: Medium — big area, mostly flat; a few steps at the gate
places.tip_en: Can be combined with the Mausoleum area — they are next to each other.
places.tip_kn: ಹೋ ಚಿ ಮಿನ್ ಸಮಾಧಿಯ ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲೇ ಇದೆ.
places.go: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, 19c Hoàng Diệu, Ba Đình, Hà Nội

places.vi: Bảo tàng Dân tộc học Việt Nam
places.addr_vi: Bảo tàng Dân tộc học Việt Nam, đường Nguyễn Văn Huyên, Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, Nguyễn Văn Huyên, Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội
places.why_en: The best museum in Hanoi. Clothes, homes, tools and festivals of Vietnam's 54 communities — easy to enjoy even without reading much. Real village houses in the garden.
places.why_kn: ಹನೋಯ್‌ನ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ವಸ್ತುಸಂಗ್ರಹಾಲಯ. ವಿಯೆಟ್ನಾಂನ 54 ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಉಡುಪು, ಮನೆ, ಸಾಧನ, ಹಬ್ಬಗಳು. ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಜವಾದ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಮನೆಗಳು.
places.best_en: Afternoon. Open 8:30 am–5:30 pm, closed Monday. About 1 hr 15 min.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Thu 26 Nov, 3:25 pm
places.walk_en: Easy indoors (step-free, wheelchairs available); garden houses have steps
places.tip_en: Good choice if it rains — most of it is indoors.
places.tip_kn: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದರೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಆಯ್ಕೆ — ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಒಳಾಂಗಣ.
places.go: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, Nguyễn Văn Huyên, Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội

places.addr_vi: Nhà thờ Lớn Hà Nội, 1 phố Nhà Thờ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: St. Joseph Cathedral, 1 P. Nhà Thờ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.why_en: A grey stone church from 1886 that looks like a small Notre-Dame of Paris. The lanes around it have cafés and pretty shops — a lovely short evening walk.
places.why_kn: 1886ರ ಬೂದು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಚರ್ಚ್, ಪ್ಯಾರಿಸ್‌ನ ನೋತ್ರ್-ದಾಮ್‌ನಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ಬೀದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಫೆ, ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು — ಸಂಜೆಯ ಸುಂದರ ನಡಿಗೆ.
places.best_en: Any time; seeing it from outside is enough. 15–20 min.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Fri 27 Nov, 1:15 pm
places.tip_en: Combine with Hoan Kiem Lake — it is 5 minutes from the lake.
places.go: St. Joseph Cathedral, 1 P. Nhà Thờ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội

places.addr_vi: Đài quan sát Lotte (tầng 65), Lotte Center, 54 Liễu Giai, Ba Đình, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Sky Lotte Observation Deck, 54 P. Liễu Giai, Ba Đình, Hà Nội
places.why_en: See all of Hanoi from 65 floors up — a fast lift does the climbing. Lakes, rivers and city lights, with a glass floor for the brave.
places.why_kn: 65 ಮಹಡಿ ಎತ್ತರದಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಹನೋಯ್ ನೋಡಿ — ಲಿಫ್ಟ್ ಇದೆ, ಹತ್ತುವ ಕೆಲಸವಿಲ್ಲ. ಸರೋವರ, ನದಿ, ನಗರದ ದೀಪಗಳು.
places.best_en: Reach about 5:00 pm — sunset is about 5:15 pm. Open until about 9 pm.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Thu 26 Nov, 5:00 pm
places.walk_en: Very easy — lift all the way
places.tip_en: Skip it on a cloudy or rainy day — you won't see much.
places.go: Sky Lotte Observation Deck, 54 P. Liễu Giai, Ba Đình, Hà Nội

places.addr_vi: Làng gốm Bát Tràng, Gia Lâm, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Bat Trang Ceramic Village, Gia Lam, Hanoi
places.why_en: A village that has made pottery for hundreds of years. Watch potters at the wheel, try making a small pot yourself, and buy cups, vases and gifts cheaper than in the city.
places.why_kn: ನೂರಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಮಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಹಳ್ಳಿ. ಕುಂಬಾರರ ಕೆಲಸ ನೋಡಿ, ನೀವೇ ಪುಟ್ಟ ಮಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಗರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಕಪ್, ಹೂದಾನಿ, ಉಡುಗೊರೆ ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
places.best_en: Morning, 8:30–11:30, when the workshops are busy. Allow about 3 hours with the drive.
places.best_kn: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ 8:30–11:30, ಕಾರ್ಯಾಗಾರಗಳು ಚುರುಕಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಸೇರಿ ಸುಮಾರು 3 ಗಂಟೆ.
places.fits_en: Not in the plan — only if you get a free half day
places.entry: Free to walk; small fee to make a pot
places.tip_en: Pottery is heavy and breaks — ask the shop to wrap it well, or buy small pieces.
places.tip_kn: ಮಡಿಕೆ ಭಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಒಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ — ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಸುತ್ತಿಸಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಸಣ್ಣದನ್ನು ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
places.go: Bát Tràng Ceramic Village, Bát Tràng, Gia Lâm, Hà Nội

places.vi: Bảo tàng Phụ nữ Việt Nam
places.addr_vi: Bảo tàng Phụ nữ Việt Nam, 36 Lý Thường Kiệt, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Vietnamese Women's Museum, 36 Lý Thường Kiệt, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.why_en: Beautiful traditional dresses, wedding customs, family life and market women's stories. Small, clean and air-conditioned — about 1 hour.
places.why_kn: ಸುಂದರ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಉಡುಪುಗಳು, ಮದುವೆ ಪದ್ಧತಿ, ಕುಟುಂಬ ಜೀವನ. ಚಿಕ್ಕ, ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ, ಎಸಿ ಇರುವ ಸ್ಥಳ — ಸುಮಾರು 1 ಗಂಟೆ.
places.best_en: Late morning. Open 8:00–5:00 daily. About 1 hr.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Sun 29 Nov, 11:15 am
places.tip_en: Good on a rainy or hot afternoon.
places.go: Vietnamese Women's Museum, 36 Lý Thường Kiệt, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội

places.vi: Di tích Nhà tù Hỏa Lò
places.addr_vi: Di tích Nhà tù Hỏa Lò, 1 phố Hỏa Lò, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Hoa Lo Prison Relic, 1 P. Hoả Lò, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.why_en: The old French-built prison where Vietnam's freedom fighters were kept — a story much like India's own freedom struggle.
places.why_kn: ಫ್ರೆಂಚರು ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಹಳೆಯ ಜೈಲು, ವಿಯೆಟ್ನಾಂ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರು — ನಮ್ಮ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದಂತೆಯೇ ಕಥೆ.
places.best_en: Morning, at opening. Open 8:00–5:00 daily. About 1 hr.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Sun 29 Nov, 9:45 am
places.tip_en: Some rooms show harsh prison scenes — skip if that upsets you.
places.tip_kn: ಕೆಲವು ಕೋಣೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಠಿಣ ದೃಶ್ಯಗಳಿವೆ — ಬೇಸರವಾದರೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡಿ.
places.go: Hoa Lo Prison Relic, 1 P. Hoả Lò, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội

places.addr_vi: Đền Bạch Mã, 76 phố Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.addr_en: Bach Ma Temple, 76 P. Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
places.why_en: The oldest temple in the Old Quarter, from the 11th century, built for a legendary white horse. Small, peaceful and full of red and gold carvings.
places.why_kn: ಹಳೆಯ ನಗರದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹಳೆಯ ದೇವಾಲಯ, 11ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ್ದು, ಬಿಳಿ ಕುದುರೆಯ ದಂತಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದು. ಚಿಕ್ಕ, ಶಾಂತ, ಕೆಂಪು-ಚಿನ್ನದ ಕೆತ್ತನೆಗಳು.
places.best_en: Late afternoon. Closes 5:00 pm. 20–30 min is enough.
places.best_kn: ಸಂಜೆಗೆ ಮುಂಚೆ. 5 ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. 20–30 ನಿಮಿಷ ಸಾಕು.
places.fits_en: In your plan: Tue 24 Nov, 3:40 pm
places.tip_en: Cover shoulders and knees. Speak softly inside.
places.tip_kn: ಭುಜ, ಮೊಣಕಾಲು ಮುಚ್ಚಿ. ಒಳಗೆ ಮೆಲ್ಲಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ.
places.go: Bach Ma Temple, 76 P. Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
